tasks.label: easyinstaller: setup config
tasks.command: cp config_sample.yaml config.yaml && echo 'Config created — edit config.yaml to customize'

tasks.label: easyinstaller: run tests
tasks.command: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v 2>/dev/null || python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/ -p 'test_*.py' -v 2>/dev/null || echo 'No tests found'
